channel.title: LoomSci - Quantum Physics
channel.description: Latest Quantum Physics articles from LoomSci

item.title: Quantum Compressed Sensing: Banishing the Logarithm
item.description: A single quantum probe, through domain-alignment evolution, directly maps sparse signal components to measurements, eliminating the logarithmic overhead of classical compressed sensing.

item.title: Breaking the Monotony: How Thermodynamic Networks Learn to Compute
item.description: By settling into a steady state, a thermodynamic network computes without clocks or logic gates, using negative differential conductance to break monotonic constraints.

item.title: Is Quantum Chaos Hiding in the Second Moment?
item.description: In a many-body spin chain, the variance of entanglement across measurement histories separates chaotic dynamics from integrable ones, unmasking quantum chaos where averages fail.

item.title: When a Quantum String Breaks Itself
item.description: For the first time, a trapped-ion quantum simulator observes non-abelian string breaking, where the force that binds quarks tears itself apart without any dynamical matter.

item.title: Learning a Quantum System's Rules at Any Temperature
item.description: A flat polynomial approximation enables learning a quantum Hamiltonian from thermal states at any constant temperature.

item.title: The Heartbeat Gauging World Models and Quantum Hardness
item.description: Wavelet variance equipartition in a world model's latent space reveals a quantum hardness boundary, linking turbulence theory to machine learning.
